name: Sudan
value: RSF drone kills 9 in Blue Nile; Kordofan battles
summary: An official said an RSF drone killed 9 civilians in Blue Nile; UNICEF says long-range drone strikes are now the norm
state: A local official said an RSF drone attack on Bani Shako village in Blue Nile state killed at least nine civilians, reported on 10 Nov (Anadolu via A News). UNICEF said on 10 Nov that drones now strike up to 1,500 km away, that up to 15 power stations were hit in October, and that two in three child casualties this year were caused by drones (UN News). The army said on 8 Nov it had taken Ayal Bakhit and Umm Marahik in West Kordofan (Yeni Şafak). Repeated deadly drone strikes on civilians and severe malnutrition keep the Alert.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan. Exposure is mainly through humanitarian need, refugee flows to neighbouring states and Red Sea trade.
rubric_hit: Massacres or mass-casualty attacks on civilians reported (Alert): repeated drone strikes, 9 killed in Blue Nile
